description: Hercules and Iolaus travel through a wider range of kingdoms and mythic dangers as gods, old friends and recurring allies complicate otherwise simple attempts to help people in trouble.

s02e01.description: When Iolaus is falsely accused of robbery, Hercules races against time to apprehend the real thief before his friend is executed.

s02e02.description: Hercules aids out his friend King Midas, whose gambling palace has gotten out of control with sadistic entertainment.

s02e03.description: A not-so-heroic Hercules imposter, hi s mortal half-brother Iphicles, is about to wed the stepdaughter of an evil warlord.

s02e04.description: Hercules and Iolaus capture Goth, wanted for war crimes, but have to take refuge in abandoned fort while Goth's brother and his army try to rescue him.

s02e05.description: Hercules aids a centaur and his family combat the prejudice of a fanatical group of townspeople seeking ethnic purity.

s02e06.description: Hercules plays Cupid to a forlorn farmer and his alluring wife, who ran away to work in a "sin bin" after the death of their two children.

s02e07.description: Echidna, the Mother of All Monsters, sets out to get Hercules for killing all her children.

s02e08.description: While trying to rescue Persephone, Hades' stolen love, Herc visits the Underworld. He's sorely tempted to stay with his beloved dead wife and children.

s02e09.description: Salmoneus is set up with treasure stolen from Hera. When Hercules convinces Nemesis that Salmoneus is innocent, Hera sends a deadly creature of fire to eliminate all three of them.

s02e10.description: Hercules and Iolaus fall in with fellow traveler Typhon, a gentle and friendly giant. They are astounded to discover he is married to Echidna, the Mother of All Monsters.

s02e11.description: Hercules has an uphill battle when he goes after King Sisyphus, who's tricked a young man into taking his place in the underworld.

s02e12.description: Hercules and Iolaus search for a mystical relic that allows nothing but the truth to be uttered in its presence.

s02e13.description: Hercules' good time at a harvest festival is interrupted by the arrival of an assassin sent by his vindictive stepmother.

s02e14.description: Hercules and Iolaus aids Jason and the Argonauts search for the Golden Fleece.

s02e15.description: Hecules is in for both love and war when he falls in love with the leader of a rebel band that is fighting a tyrant.

s02e16.description: Hercules promotes peace by organizing an athletic competition between the warring Spartans and Eleans, thus creating the Olympic Games.

s02e17.description: Aphrodite manipulates Iolaus into judging a contest between three goddesses, and the enchanted golden apple he accepts makes a royal bride fall in love with him, threatening peace between two rival kingdoms.

s02e18.description: Hercules and Iolaus get caught in the middle of a love triangle when they volunteer to help a king rescue his abducted fiancée.

s02e19.description: Iolaus finds he has a royal look-alike and ends up helping him defend his throne from a jealous brother and a conniving general.

s02e20.description: A friend of Hercules and Iolaus is accused of theft when an angry god distorts reality by making people appear to have performed acts they didn't.

s02e21.description: The wedding of Hercules' mother to the legendary Greek hero Jason is threatened by another of Hera's plans to kill Hercules.

s02e22.description: Hercules intervenes when a young man with divine powers is manipulated by a relative into using his gift for villanious purposes.

s02e23.description: A dying centaur asks Hercules for help when a centaur group's struggle for equal rights with humans takes a violent turn.

s02e24.description: An eager young writer discovers a lesson about courage when he aids Hercules and Iolaus rescue a maiden trapped in a cave.
